description_en: Queries the classification and grading rules of Data Security Guard
description_zh: 调用QuerySensNodeInfo接口查询数据保护伞的分类分级识别规则
name: QuerySensNodeInfo

parameters.help_en: The ID of the classification and grading template. You can obtain the ID by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2743948.html operation
parameters.help_zh: 分类分级模板ID。可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2743948.html接口获取
parameters.name: template_id

parameters.help_en: The tenant ID. To obtain the tenant ID, log on to the DataWorks console (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console), go to the DataStudio page, click the username in the upper-right corner, and then choose Menu > User Info
parameters.help_zh: 租户ID。您可登录DataWorks控制台 (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)，进入数据开发（DataStudio）页面，单击右上方当前登录用户名称，选择菜单 > 用户信息，获取租户ID
parameters.name: tenant_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the classification and grading node. You can obtain the ID by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2746850.html operation, or by logging on to the DataWorks console (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console) and going to the Data Security Guard page
parameters.help_zh: 分类分级节点ID。可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2746850.html接口获取，或登录DataWorks控制台 (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)，进入数据保护伞界面直接获取
parameters.name: node_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the sensitive field. You can obtain the name by logging on to the DataWorks console (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console) and going to the Data Security Guard page
parameters.help_zh: 敏感字段名称。您可登录DataWorks控制台 (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)，进入数据保护伞界面直接获取
parameters.name: sensitive_name

parameters.help_en: The page number for paging. Valid values: integers starting from 1
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询页码数。取值：从1开始
parameters.name: page_no

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page for paging. Valid values: 10 to 1000. Recommended values: 10 to 100
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询每页显示的条数。取值：10~1000，建议大小为10~100
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The status of the sensitive field. Valid values:
0: Draft.
1: Published
parameters.help_zh:
敏感字段的状态。取值如下：
0：草稿态。
1：发布态
parameters.name: status

Data.description_en: The business data returned in JSON format
Data.example: {"success": true, "httpStatusCode": 200, "data": { "result": [ { "sensitiveName": "certificate expiration date", "sensitiveId": "fd4ff5a2-9537-43d1-8e4f-1d0b5ffaac12", "status": 0, "templateName": "built-in classification and grading template", "keyRuleId": "228248921215042 certificate expiration date"} ], "totalCount": 1, "currentPage": 1, "pageSize": 10 }, "requestId": 10000001}

RequestId.description_zh: 请求ID，一次请求的唯一标识

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful. Valid values:
true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
调用是否成功。
true：成功。
false：失败
